ZeroSlack document editor resources

PDF reading: PDF.js / pdfjs-dist 6.5.438, Apache-2.0 license.
The unmodified distribution archive, package metadata and license are included.
The reader also retains the upstream font, image decoder and color profile
licenses alongside their corresponding runtime resources under pdf/vendor/.

Markdown: MarkText 0.23.0, Muya workspace source, commit
18fdc1eddc7d36d9b205180d058982f71f4f6373. MIT license.

The complete pinned upstream source archives are provided in sources/.
The build recipes, lockfiles, host adapters and modified Muya source
are also provided there. Published npm dependencies are identified
in licenses/*-dependencies.json. Their licenses and font notices accompany
the corresponding package metadata. WebView2Loader is distributed under
the included Microsoft WebView2 SDK license. WebView2 Runtime is a separate
machine prerequisite; the resource bundle does not redistribute that runtime.

Build adaptations:
- Muya Prism dynamic language imports become explicit local bundle chunks.
- Muya relative image display uses the host's bounded virtual asset origin;
  Markdown retains its relative paths. The modified resolver is in sources/.
- Muya structured operations use document-level
  SharedWorkers for content and undo history shared by independent views.
All other editing behavior is supplied by the pinned upstream implementations.

Open Sans font metadata identifies Version 3.000 and Copyright 2020 The
Open Sans Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/opensans).
The matching OFL 1.1 text was obtained from that project's OFL.txt:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/googlefonts/opensans/main/OFL.txt
SHA-256: 01cd5ffb3a528c219a86e49a814c6c53bd8a69b9a3c305dd237074ba1c811af7
